usage.cost_basis: codex: not reported by the CLI (credits); tokens only

phrases.known: can you give me the answer?
I'm going to give you more time
I'm not sure if I can give you that book
phrases.target: 그 책을 줄 수 있을지 모르겠어요

phrases.known: give me the answer before you go
phrases.target: 가기 전에 답을 줄 수 있으면 좋겠어요

phrases.known: I want to know if you can give me the book that you were talking about earlier.
phrases.target: 아까 말했던 그 책을 저한테 줄 수 있는지 알고 싶어요.

phrases.known: yes, I think I can give you a little more time if you need to finish the most important job.
phrases.target: 네, 가장 중요한 일을 끝내야 하면 시간을 조금 더 줄 수 있을 것 같아요.

phrases.known: sorry, I couldn't give you the answer yesterday because I didn't know what you wanted.
phrases.target: 미안해요, 뭘 원했는지 몰랐어요, 그래서 어제 답을 줄 수 없었어요.

phrases.known: thank you, but I can't give you all the answers now.
phrases.target: 고마워요, 하지만 지금 모든 답을 줄 수 없어요.

phrases.known: no problem. I'll give you the book as soon as possible, so don't worry.
phrases.target: 문제없어요. 가능한 한 빨리 책을 줄 거예요, 그러니까 걱정하지 않아요.
